Palacký University Olomouc is proud to be a part of Aurora, a consortium that gathers nine top research universities under the banner of the European Commission’s flagship European Universities Initiative. Find out below what UP’s participation in Aurora can mean for you as an employee at Palacký University.
COIL in practice: UP and UPEC students learn together across borders
The Aurora European Universities Alliance is currently expanding its central team and is looking for a new Project Manager to join its office in Amsterdam. This is an exciting opportunity […]
Study online at VU Amsterdam: explore geographical data or digital business

“Thanks to a research internship at the University of Naples Federico II within the Aurora network, I had the opportunity to get involved in research in the field of condensed matter physics. The research focused on time crystals, i.e. systems that spontaneously exhibit persistent oscillations. It was a great opportunity to become familiar with another area of theoretical physics and gain first-hand experience with research work.”

In the Aurora 2030 project, we will intensify the collaboration with our associate partners: Pavol Jozef Šafárik University in Košice (Slovakia), V.N. Karazin Kharkiv National University (Ukraine), South-West University” Neofit Rilski” (Bulgaria) and University of Tetova (North Macedonia).

In the Aurora 2030 project, we will intensify the collaboration with our associate partners: Pavol Jozef Šafárik University in Košice (Slovakia), V.N. Karazin Kharkiv National University (Ukraine), South-West University” Neofit Rilski” (Bulgaria) and University of Tetova (North Macedonia).

At the two campuses at Duisburg and Essen and at the university hospital, you meet 42,000 students from more than 130 countries. The university embraces diversity and strongly supports exchange and collaboration, both regionally – as with the neighbouring universities in the University Alliance Ruhr – and worldwide, as in the network Aurora, and with more than 250 Erasmus partner universities.
